PathSpec.description: One place to look for skills inside a source.

exclude.description: Regular expression rejecting skills whose path under `path` matches.

path.description:
Directory to search, relative to the source root.

A directory holding a `SKILL.md` is itself the skill; otherwise its
subdirectories are searched.

recurse.description: Search the whole subtree rather than only the immediate children.

RepoSpec.description: One source of skills: a git repository, or the config file's own directory.

paths.description: Where to look for skills inside the source.

repo.description:
A git URL, a path to a git repository, or `local` for the directory
holding this config file.

revision.description:
The git revision to check out: a tag, a branch or a commit.

Required for a git source, and forbidden on `local`.

description: Declares where Agent Skills come from and which directories they are deployed into.

repos.description: The sources to pull skills from.

targets.description:
Directories the skills are deployed into, each getting a full copy.

A relative path resolves against the working directory, and a leading
`~` is expanded. Defaults to `.claude/skills` and `.agents/skills`.

title: skillmgr configuration
